document.about: LAPP innovation catalogue, spring 2026 (36 pages). Its product pages share one template: box headings and the close of a standard description stand at the same place on page after page, and a thumb index runs down the side margin.

notes: #131, #132: each product page sets its Benefits and Application ranges boxes in two columns, under a lead paragraph across them, beside a side tab of turned labels at the page’s edge.

checks.issue: The box’s two columns were read line by line in turn, so each item ran into the other column’s lines.
checks.text: Kits for the production of a rectangular connector with optimally matched components to reduce ordering effort and avoid incorrect orders.
